title: Safe Deposit Boxes: keys issued, key deposit and lock change fee by box size
content:
## Scope

This card sets out, for every size in the Safe Deposit Boxes line, three key-related values: how many keys the lessee receives when the lease starts, the key deposit, and the lock change fee.

## Definitions

- **Keys issued.** The number of keys issued to the lessee at the start of the lease.
- **Key deposit.** A refundable deposit charged when the keys are issued.
- **Lock change fee.** The fee for changing the lock of the box after a key is lost or is not returned.

## Values by box size

| Official box size | Keys issued at lease start | Key deposit (refundable) | Lock change fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | 2 keys | $25.00 | $125.00 |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | 2 keys | $25.00 | $125.00 |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | 2 keys | $25.00 | $125.00 |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | 2 keys | $25.00 | $150.00 |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | 2 keys | $25.00 | $150.00 |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | 2 keys | $25.00 | $175.00 |

## Basis Q&A

**Does the number of keys or the deposit depend on the box size?** No. Every size is issued 2 keys, and the key deposit is $25.00 for every size.

**Which value does depend on the box size?** The lock change fee: $125.00 for the 3x5, 3x10 and 5x10 sizes, $150.00 for the 10x10 and 10x15 sizes, and $175.00 for the 10x20 size.

**Is the key deposit a fee the bank keeps?** It is defined as a refundable deposit, charged at the moment the keys are issued.

**When does the lock change fee come into question?** It is the charge for changing the lock after a key is lost or not returned.
